question: What teaching about the practice of the soul has now been given to the Goddess Bhairavī?
premises: A practice concerning the soul is in question.
It has been told to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of the practice was given in preceding verses rather than here.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
